mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that triggers equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >55% of instances with UNRATE >4.0% for 2 months, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) below 12-month moving averages signal broad demand contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Negative returns fail in >60% of cases with both HOUST and RSAFS declining, or interaction term p-value >0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 105.0 signals supply chain stress that intensifies recession fears, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >55% of INDPRO <105.0 instances, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >55% of CPIAUCSL YoY >3.0% instances, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Nonfarm payrolls exceeding 150,000 monthly jobs signals robust labor market conditions that support earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days without thresholds.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >55% of PAYEMS >150k instances, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion characterized by RSAFS and HOUST in top 10% of historical values signals stretched valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur in >55% of top 10% RSAFS/HOUST instances, or interaction term p-value >0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production below 106.0 and unemployment rise above 3.8% signals dual supply-labor shock, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur in >55% of INDPRO<106.0 and UNRATE>3.8% instances, or interaction term p-value >0.05.
